attributes.name: Dwarven Plate
attributes.powers:
Display this card. While displayed, reduce Combat damage dealt to you by 1.

While displayed, you may recharge this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to you by 3.

While displayed, if proficient with heavy armors, you may bury this card to reduce all damage dealt to you to 0.
